title_zh: 准备向导师提出延期请求

scenario.label_zh: 准备向导师提出延期请求
scenario.goal_zh: 回应同学自述的疲惫与担心并约定帮助草拟延期请求

context_zh: 两位成年学生讨论虚构课程作业压力。对话为支持性沟通练习，不作心理诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: I'm utterly exhausted, and I'm troubled by how little of the draft I've finished.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: You've undoubtedly had a difficult week. Does your tutor know the project is behind schedule?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Not yet. I keep putting off the email because I don't know how to ask for more time.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: We can draft a clear request together: what's finished, what's left, and how much extra time you're asking for.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Would you read it once I've written those points down?

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: Of course. I can't promise the tutor will agree, but you don't have to compose the message alone.
